label: Sleeping
explanation: We assume people sleep about 8 of 24 hours, concentrated at local night (per-country day curves refine this). "Right now" = population x the share of the day spent asleep x how deep into the local night it is.

sources.title: Eurostat HETUS (Harmonised European Time Use Survey)
Our World in Data - Time Use

formula: right now = pop x 8.0h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Awake
explanation: Derived as population minus sleeping, so the two always add up to the total. No separate assumption.

sources.title: Eurostat HETUS (Harmonised European Time Use Survey)

formula: right now = pop x 16.0h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Dreaming (REM)
explanation: REM sleep is roughly 1.5-2 h of the night. We spread it over the local sleep period and never let it exceed the sleeping counter.
formula: right now = pop x 1.75h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Waking up right now
explanation: About once a day per person, in the local morning, lasting about 5 minutes.
formula: rate = pop x 1.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 300 s

label: Going to bed right now
explanation: About once a day, in the local evening/night, lasting about 2 minutes.
formula: rate = pop x 1.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 120 s

label: On the toilet
explanation: People spend about 10 minutes a day on the toilet, peaking after waking and after meals. This is the parent for peeing/pooping.

sources.title: BACH study / clinical reference on voiding frequency (6-7x/day)
Popcol study / Heaton et al. on bowel habit (~1/day, ~5 min)

formula: right now = pop x 0.17h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Peeing right now
explanation: The average adult urinates about 6-7 times a day (BACH study), about 25 s each, spread over waking hours with morning/evening peaks. Capped at "on the toilet".

sources.title: BACH study / clinical reference on voiding frequency (6-7x/day)

formula: rate = pop x 6.5/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 25 s

label: Pooping right now
explanation: About once a day, about 5 minutes (Popcol study / Heaton et al.), usually in the morning. Capped at "on the toilet".

sources.title: Popcol study / Heaton et al. on bowel habit (~1/day, ~5 min)

formula: rate = pop x 1.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 300 s

label: Showering right now
explanation: About 0.7 times a day, about 8 minutes, usually in the morning.
formula: rate = pop x 0.7/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 480 s

label: Washing hands right now
explanation: About 8 times a day, about 20 s each (after the toilet, before eating).
formula: rate = pop x 8.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 20 s

label: Brushing teeth right now
explanation: Twice a day, about 2 minutes, morning and evening.
formula: rate = pop x 2.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 120 s

label: Sneezing right now
explanation: A few times a day, a couple of seconds each. Rough estimate.
formula: rate = pop x 4.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 2 s

label: Coughing right now
explanation: Around 10 times a day when sick, less otherwise; a few seconds each. Rough estimate.
formula: rate = pop x 10.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 3 s

label: Yawning right now
explanation: About 8 times a day, about 5 s, when tired (morning/afternoon/evening peaks).

sources.title: Physiology reference (StatPearls): blink 15-20/min, breathing 12-20/min, heart rate 60-100/min

formula: rate = pop x 8.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 5 s

label: Swallowing right now
explanation: Saliva is swallowed about once a minute while awake (~1,500 times/day), about 1 s each.

sources.title: Physiology reference (StatPearls): blink 15-20/min, breathing 12-20/min, heart rate 60-100/min

formula: rate = pop x 1500.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 1 s

label: Farting right now
explanation: About 10-20 times a day (clinical literature estimate), a few seconds each.
formula: rate = pop x 15.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 3 s

label: Blinking right now
explanation: 15-20 blinks per minute while awake (~15,000/day), about 0.3 s each.

sources.title: Physiology reference (StatPearls): blink 15-20/min, breathing 12-20/min, heart rate 60-100/min

formula: rate = pop x 15000.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 0.3 s

label: Breathing right now
explanation: 12-20 breaths per minute (~20,000/day). "Right now" counts people mid-inhale (~1.5 s of a ~4 s cycle, so ~35% of people); the per-second rate shown big is the more interesting number.

sources.title: Physiology reference (StatPearls): blink 15-20/min, breathing 12-20/min, heart rate 60-100/min

formula: rate = pop x 20000.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 1.5 s

label: Heartbeats right now
explanation: 60-100 beats per minute at rest (~100,000/day), ~0.8 s per beat - so about 93% of people are mid-beat at any moment.

sources.title: Physiology reference (StatPearls): blink 15-20/min, breathing 12-20/min, heart rate 60-100/min

formula: rate = pop x 100000.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 0.8 s

label: Eating right now
explanation: 60-135 minutes a day depending on the country (OECD time-use data), peaking at local breakfast/lunch/dinner times.

sources.title: Eurostat HETUS (Harmonised European Time Use Survey)
Our World in Data - Time Use

formula: right now = pop x 1.5h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Taking a bite right now
explanation: About 60-110 bites per meal, ~3 meals a day, ~2 s per bite - only while eating.
formula: rate = pop x 250.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 2 s

label: Taking a sip right now
explanation: About 50 sips of a drink per day, ~2 s each.
formula: rate = pop x 50.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 2 s

label: Drinking coffee right now
explanation: About 2.25 billion cups of coffee are drunk worldwide per day (NCA/ICO), so ~0.28 cups per person per day; a cup takes ~20 min to drink.

sources.title: International Coffee Organization - ~2.25 bn cups/day globally

formula: rate = pop x 0.28/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 1200 s

label: Cooking right now
explanation: About half the population cooks on a given day, ~30 min, around meal times.

sources.title: Eurostat HETUS (Harmonised European Time Use Survey)

formula: rate = pop x 0.5/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 1800 s

label: Having sex right now
explanation: About 7% of adults (15+) have sex on an average day (frequency surveys: Durex, Natsal, GSS, NSFG); the median session lasts ~5.4 min (Waldinger et al. 2005). Peaks in the local evening/night.

sources.title: Waldinger et al. 2005, J Sex Med - IELT median 5.4 min
Durex Global Sex Survey (sex frequency by country)
Natsal (UK National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles)
GSS (US General Social Survey) sexual frequency
NSFG (US National Survey of Family Growth)

formula: rate = popM15plus + popF15plus x 0.07/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 324 s

label: Male ejaculation right now
explanation: Follows the sex rate - about 6% of adult men per day; the ejaculation itself lasts ~5-15 s.

sources.title: Waldinger et al. 2005, J Sex Med - IELT median 5.4 min
Durex Global Sex Survey (sex frequency by country)

formula: rate = popM15plus x 0.06/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 10 s

label: Female orgasm right now
explanation: About 5% of adult women per day; the orgasm itself lasts tens of seconds (time from penetration to orgasm is ~13 min on average, Bhat & Shastry 2020).

sources.title: Bhat & Shastry 2020, J Sex Med - time to female orgasm ~13 min
Durex Global Sex Survey (sex frequency by country)
Natsal (UK National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles)

formula: rate = popF15plus x 0.05/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 20 s

label: Kissing right now
explanation: A couple of times a day, ~10 s each, mostly in the evening. Estimate.
formula: rate = popM15plus + popF15plus x 2.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 10 s

label: Hugging right now
explanation: About 3 times a day, ~15 s each. Estimate.
formula: rate = pop x 3.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 15 s

label: Online right now
explanation: About two thirds of the world's population is online (~5.5 bn, DataReportal); averaged over everyone that is ~16 h/day, weighted to local evenings. Never more than "awake".
formula: right now = pop x 16.3h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Scrolling social media right now
explanation: About 1 hour a day on social media (DataReportal), mostly evenings. Never more than "awake" or "online".
formula: right now = pop x 1.0h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Watching video/TV right now
explanation: About 2.5 hours a day of video/TV (DataReportal), mostly evenings.
formula: right now = pop x 2.5h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Googling right now
explanation: Google handles ~99,000 searches per second (~8.5 bn/day), i.e. about 1 search per person per day, ~20 s each.

sources.title: Google published search volume (~99,000 searches/s, ~8.5 bn/day)

formula: rate = pop x 1.05/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 20 s

label: Gaming right now
explanation: About 0.5 h/day on games, mostly evenings. Estimate from games-industry usage stats.
formula: right now = pop x 0.5h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Driving right now
explanation: About 30 min/day per person on average including non-drivers (OECD time-use), with rush-hour peaks. Never more than "awake".
formula: right now = pop x 0.5h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: On public transport right now
explanation: About 15 min/day on buses/trains (OECD time-use), rush hours.
formula: right now = pop x 0.25h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: In a flight right now
explanation: About 100,000 commercial flights a day (~1-2 million people airborne, ICAO/FlightRadar24) - about 0.002 flights per person per day, ~3 h average flight.

sources.title: FlightRadar24 - ~10,000-20,000 commercial flights airborne at once

formula: rate = pop x 0.00185/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 10800 s

label: Doing paid work right now
explanation: Paid work averages ~5.5 h/day per adult (ILO/OECD), concentrated on weekdays 8-18 local time, low on weekends. Never more than "awake".

sources.title: ILO - labour force and working time

formula: right now = popM15plus + popF15plus x 5.5h/24 x dayCurve(localTime, weekday)

label: Being born right now
explanation: UN WPP 2024: about 4.3 babies born per second worldwide, roughly uniform over the day. This is what grows the world-population stat.
formula: rate = pop x 4.59e-05/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 60 s

label: Dying right now
explanation: UN WPP 2024: about 1.9 people die per second worldwide, roughly uniform over the day.
formula: rate = pop x 2.02e-05/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 60 s

label: Crying right now
explanation: About once a day, ~2 min. Rough estimate.
formula: rate = pop x 1.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 120 s

label: Laughing right now
explanation: About 10 times a day, ~5 s each. Rough estimate, mostly evenings.
formula: rate = pop x 10.0/day x dayCurve(localTime, weekday) / 86400; right now = rate x 5 s
